free_tier.stated: no free tier: a real iPhone is USD 60 per month and a real Mac is USD 90 per month, each billed month to month

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a dedicated physical device, not a stored object

retention.stated: The device is dedicated to one renter and keeps apps, files and sign-ins between tasks until release; on release the data is erased, the device is factory reset and its controller is wiped. After a failed renewal, access continues for up to 72 hours before the device is released and reset.
retention.notes: A rental is month to month and ends at the end of the current billing period; no automatic daily or hourly expiry.

egress.terms: not published: the pricing, terms, homepage and agent instructions state no outbound data allowance or price; screen frames and input are buffered in memory between the device and the browser or agent, and an eSIM plan on an iPhone is bought separately from a carrier.

interface_detail: A REST API at https://api.glasshand.com/v1 with screen capture, screenshot JPEG and click, drag, scroll and key input over JSON or a control WebSocket; a human dashboard at https://app.glasshand.com and OpenAPI reference at https://api.glasshand.com/openapi.json; no native shell, filesystem mount or clipboard API.
tooling: An agent with HTTPS access calls the REST API directly after device-code authorization; no installation or MCP server is required; the user approves the agent and pays through Stripe in a browser.
chaining: A dedicated iPhone or Mac with real App Store apps and sign-ins serves an agent workflow; data must be copied to a separate storage record before release because the device is wiped.

limits.value: device authorization needs email OTP sign-in and explicit agent approval; approval link alone grants no API access; payment is a separate Stripe checkout in the human browser
API returns HTTP 429 Rate limited; back off; poll device token no faster than the returned interval, normally 5 seconds; up to 8 simultaneous viewers and 1 active controller
monthly rental only, no hourly or day rate; text input at most 512 US-layout ASCII characters per call; at most four unacknowledged frames in a control stream

limits_note: Devices are physical, available by month only and not shared; only one iPhone model (iPhone SE third generation) is offered at launch, and camera input is not supported.
binding_note: Access stops at the human approval and payment step before any API call or device control is possible; the monthly-only rental then sets the cost floor.

identity_cost.detail: Sign-in uses a one-time code sent to an email address, with no password. Agent access needs a device-code request, an email OTP sign-in and explicit approval of agent name and permissions; approval alone grants no API access. Payment is a separate Stripe checkout where the user provides a valid payment method, billing address and tax information; accounts require age 18 and are open to individuals worldwide.

reliability_note: A failed renewal leaves up to 72 hours of access before the device is released and wiped; no uptime is guaranteed, device access depends on hardware availability, and iOS can withhold a permission dialog from the captured image while blocking input.
confidence_note: Prices, billing, sign-in and payment gate, API interface, input caps, 429 backoff and reset terms are quoted from Glasshand's own pricing, terms, homepage, agent instructions and API specification read on 2026-11-24.
